title: WatchedFolder
description: A user-approved folder whose completed video files are imported automatically (spec 6.1, 8.1.2, M07). The desktop host watches it and reports stable files; the worker decides whether to import. Nothing in a watched folder is ever moved, renamed, or deleted.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder. Local data: never logged.

mode.description: Import mode for files found here.

enabled.description: Disabled folders are not watched, scanned, or imported from.

last_scan_at.description: When the host last finished a reconciliation scan.

availability.description: Reported by the host: whether the folder could be read at the last check.

last_error.description: Why the folder was unavailable at the last check.

Patterns.title: Patterns
Patterns.description: Glob patterns over '/'-separated paths relative to the folder, matched case-insensitively. A pattern without '/' matches the file name; one with '/' matches the whole relative path. '*' and '?' stay within one path segment; '**' spans segments. Only supported video files are ever candidates, whatever 'include' says.

WatchedFolderStats.title: WatchedFolderStats
WatchedFolderStats.description: Files the worker has seen in this folder, by the state of their latest import.

WatchedFolderRequest.title: WatchedFolderRequest
WatchedFolderRequest.description: Create (POST, 'path' required) or change (PATCH, 'path' not allowed) a watched folder. Omitted fields keep their current value or default: source_kind 'other', mode 'reference', recursive true, the default include/exclude patterns, enabled true.

WatchedFileReport.title: WatchedFileReport
WatchedFileReport.description: Sent by the host for a file whose size and modification time stayed unchanged for the stabilization period and that could be opened for reading.

WatchedFileDecision.title: WatchedFileDecision
WatchedFileDecision.description: The worker's answer to a report. 'queued': an import job was submitted. 'known': this exact version (path, size, mtime) was already imported or found unimportable. 'in_progress': its import is still running. 'backoff': its last import failed with a retryable error and 'retry_at' has not passed. 'ignored': the file does not match the folder's patterns.

WatchedFile.title: WatchedFile
WatchedFile.description: The worker's record of one file in a watched folder (its latest version).

ScanReport.title: ScanReport
ScanReport.description: Sent by the host after each availability check or reconciliation scan.

scanned.description: True when a full reconciliation scan finished (sets last_scan_at).
